verdict.rationale: Xero documents direct bank feed connections that auto-import and categorize transactions (xero-docs-27, xero-docs-20), Stripe payment integrations for receiving payments (xero-docs-23, xero-docs-30), bill payment automation (xero-docs-24, xero-docs-25), and a broad developer API/SDK ecosystem for further integrations (xero-docs-1, xero-gh-3). Payroll-specific ledger integration isn't explicitly documented in this pack, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs is thin. missing for 10: explicit payroll system connection/sync evidence, independent third-party verification of automatic reconciliation accuracy.
